name: cmdb_graph_rel
label: Configuration Management graph_rel Table
description: Configure the configuration management graph_rel table, which belongs to the configuration management module. It can be used for related query scenarios in configuration management, such as reporting.

fields.name: from_graph_id
fields.description: From_graph association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: to_graph_id
fields.description: to_graph association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
